input.query: SELECT date_trunc('week', decision_date)::DATE AS week_start, platform, doc_type, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions),0) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='iOS' AND lower(doc_type) LIKE '%driving%' AND decision_date >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND decision_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', event_date)::DATE AS week_start, platform, doc_type, app_version, COUNT(*) AS attempts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_kyc_approved) AS approved, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS approval_rate FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE platform='iOS' AND lower(doc_type) LIKE '%driving%' AND event_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,4
